set.body:
Outcome
Support live density and enlarged text without stale geometry or pane reconstruction.

Owned scope
Dock.scala; DockRegion.scala; views.scala; drag.scala; sizing.scala; geometry/drag/divider/minimize suites

Prerequisites
S1

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Introduce a public FX-thread metrics update path; every renderer, minimized strip, geometry computation and drag hit-test consumes the same current metrics snapshot.
- [x] Reject invalid/non-finite/negative metrics according to an explicit documented contract and define effective minima for zero/tiny available space.
- [x] Cancel an armed/active pane or divider drag safely before metrics change; clear ghost/preview/cursors and ensure the next gesture uses the new geometry.
- [x] Switch headers 32→28→32 and enlarged-text metrics with existing/new/restored floats; assert actual header/content bounds agree with model hit-tests.
- [x] Keep pane Node identities, selected IDs, scientific/application state, split ownership and saved-layout schema intact; do not dispose/recreate the dock.
- [x] Honor dynamic text/control preferred minima at the adapter boundary instead of treating density height as an absolute clipping ceiling.

Required evidence
Sizing/geometry assertions, DragDropSuite/DividerSuite/MinimizeFxSuite/PopoutSuite regressions and instance/state counters.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S2. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.

Accepted locally: docs/evidence/meridian-s2/README.md. Six criteria complete; independent provider-wide qualification remains S6. macOS/aarch64 only; no publication or Meridian pin update.
